description: Generate ready-to-use Web Component code using Mozaic Design System (@mozaic-ds/web-components). Returns HTML with custom elements and import statement.

attributes.description: HTML attributes to apply (all values as strings). Use 'true'/'false' for boolean attributes.

component.description: Component type to generate (e.g., 'button', 'card', 'modal'). Will be converted to kebab-case tag name.

name: generate_webcomponent
